headline: [Tragedy at Sea!] Migrant Boat Found Off Spain's Canary Islands With [14 Dead]
caption:
🌊 Tragedy at Sea! Migrant Boat Found Off Spain's Canary Islands With 14 Dead

Fourteen people died on a migrant boat found adrift about 72 km south of El Hierro, one of Spain's Canary Islands, on Friday, Spanish news agency EFE reported. Ninety people on board were rescued by Spain's sea rescue service, the Civil Guard and a helicopter.

🔹 Six people in serious condition were flown by helicopter to hospital on El Hierro. The other 84 survivors were taken by boat to the port of La Restinga.
🔹 According to EFE and El País, the boat left Banjul in The Gambia 10 days earlier, and its engine had failed three days before it was found.
🔹 Canary Islands leader Fernando Clavijo said the emergency "doesn't start on El Hierro, but on the shores of Senegal and Gambia, where we have to act." More than 2,100 people arrived on the islands earlier this week, most of them on El Hierro.

headline: [Heartbreaking!] WWE Star Bronson Reed Dies at [Age 38]
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Heartbreaking! WWE Star Bronson Reed Dies at Age 38

WWE star Bronson Reed, whose real name was Jermaine Haley, has died at the age of 38. WWE announced on Friday that he died due to "medical complications" and did not give more details.

🔹 Reed was born in Adelaide, South Australia. He made his WWE main roster debut in 2022, won the Andre the Giant Memorial Battle Royal in 2024 and was a former NXT North American champion.
🔹 His last WWE appearance was at the Crown Jewel event in Saudi Arabia earlier this month, in a match against Oba Femi.
🔹 WWE called him "a larger-than-life figure" and "a devoted family man." He is survived by his pregnant wife, Paige, and their daughter.

Sources: ESPN, ABC News, WWE statement
